text: Obadiah: Heb. Obadiahu | the governor: Heb. over his house
lest not all the beasts: Heb. that we are not cut off ourselves from the beasts
it is well spoken: Heb. the word is good
hear: Or, answer | answered: Or, heard | leapt upon the altar: Or, leaped up and down at the altar
aloud: Heb. with a great voice | he is talking: Or, he meditateth | is pursuing: Heb. hath a pursuit
the blood gushed out upon them: Heb. poured out blood upon them
offering: Heb. ascending | any that regarded: Heb. attention
a sound of abundance of rain: Or, a sound of a noise of rain
to the entrance of Jezreel: Heb. till thou come to Jezreel
